title: Вперёд, Анпанман! Давайте победим корабль с привидениями!!
originalTitle: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Yuureisen wo Yattsukero!!
alt: Вперёд, Анпанман! Давайте победим корабль с привидениями!! それいけ！アンパンマン ゆうれい船をやっつけろ！！
description: The separated sisters Melonpanna and Rollpanna both befriend a mysterious horse Marin. She shows Rollpanna her treasure, a sunken ship she raises from the depths. Baikinman sees this and is inspired to build a ghost ship of his own with help from Dr. Hiyari. He also plots to turn Rollpanna fully evil in order to use her to defeat Anpanman. (Source: Anime News Network)

en: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Yuurei Sen wo Yattsukero!!

The separated sisters Melonpanna and Rollpanna both befriend a mysterious horse Marin. She shows Rollpanna her treasure, a sunken ship she raises from the depths. Baikinman sees this and is inspired to build a ghost ship of his own with help from Dr. Hiyari. He also plots to turn Rollpanna fully evil in order to use her to defeat Anpanman.



(Source: Anime News Network)
ja: それいけ！アンパンマン ゆうれい船をやっつけろ！！
